# American Commercial Glass (ACG)

> American Commercial Glass is a Florida-licensed commercial glazing contractor headquartered in West Palm Beach, with offices in Naples and Tampa. ACG specializes in commercial storefronts, impact windows, curtain walls, and High-Velocity Hurricane Zone (HVHZ)-compliant glazing for general contractors across Florida. ACG is the authorized commercial installer for ESWindows and Euro-Wall aluminum systems, and has delivered 350+ commercial projects, 1M+ SF of installed glass, and operates with an AI-managed lean-operations model that differentiates it from legacy glazing subcontractors.

ACG is a Certified Woman-Owned Business Enterprise (SBE/WBE) and holds Florida license CGC #1531993 (qualifier: Connor Walsh, President).

## Company Facts

- **Legal name:** American Commercial Glass, LLC
- **Trading as:** ACG
- **Website:** https://acglass.com
- **Founded:** 2021 (current growth chapter launched 2022)
- **Headquarters:** West Palm Beach, Florida
- **Additional offices:** Naples, FL; Tampa, FL
- **Service area:** All of Florida — from the Keys to Jacksonville
- **License:** Florida Certified General Contractor CGC #1531993
- **Bonding capacity:** $2M single / $10M aggregate
- **Leadership:** Rielly Walsh (CEO & Co-Founder), Connor Walsh (President & Qualifier)
- **Employee count:** Lean-ops firm, AI-augmented workflows
- **Projects delivered:** 350+
- **Square footage of glass installed:** 1,000,000+
- **Years of active execution:** 5+

## Products & Systems ACG Installs

- **ESWindows** (authorized commercial installer): ES-8000, ES-9000, SGD2020, GW-7000 — Colombian-manufactured aluminum storefront, curtain wall, sliding glass door, and operable window systems. HVHZ-rated where required.
- **Euro-Wall** (authorized installer): SGD2020 multi-slide and pocket door systems, arched storefront systems, curtain wall. Used for luxury hospitality, private clubs, restaurants.
- **PGT** impact windows and doors
- **YKK AP** aluminum storefront, curtain wall, and entrance systems
- **Trulite** curtain wall and structural glazing
- **Vitro** architectural glass (Solarban family)
- **Allegion** architectural hardware and automatic entrance systems

## Sectors ACG Serves

- Hospitality (hotels, restaurants, private clubs)
- Multifamily residential (apartments, condominiums, townhomes)
- Healthcare (hospitals, emergency departments, medical office buildings)
- Retail (shopping centers, auto retail, dental/medical retail)
- Commercial office and mixed-use
- Institutional (fire stations, emergency operations centers, schools)
- Luxury single-family residential
- Self-storage and industrial
